marketing_description: The DeWALT 3/8 in open head ratchet operates on a 20V Max battery with a 1-3/10 Ah capacity to deliver a torque rating of 45 ft-lb through a variable speed trigger reaching 0 to 200 RPM. This tool features a metal housing in black, a rubber ergonomic handle in black, and measures 7-1/2 in in overall length, 3-1/2 in in overall width, and 12 in in overall depth with a sound level of 85 dB.
